core_obligations: (1) The two diagonal identities; properness is the hypothesis.

(2) Coefficient of Z in alpha·beta as the alternating Tor-length sum at xi; the same for Delta(Z) on X x X; the tor-and-diagonal affine sub-claim equates the Tor modules at Delta(xi); lengths equal (length-independence cited).
(3) pr_{1,*} ∘ Delta_* = id via the compose-pushforward lemma.
proof_roadmap: identity setup + pointwise Tor comparison + composition
